description: This file defines the INoteService interface for handling note-related operations in the notes management system, including create, retrieve, update, and delete actions.

classes.name: INoteService
classes.description: Interface for note service operations with asynchronous methods for creating, retrieving, updating, and deleting notes.

methods.name: CreateAsync
methods.description: Creates a new note for a specific user asynchronously.

methods.name: GetAllAsync
methods.description: Retrieves all notes for a specific user asynchronously.

methods.name: GetByIdAsync
methods.description: Retrieves a specific note by its ID for a specific user asynchronously.

methods.name: UpdateAsync
methods.description: Updates an existing note by its ID for a specific user asynchronously.

methods.name: DeleteAsync
methods.description: Deletes a specific note by its ID for a user asynchronously.
